name: Active-power indicator
summary: An active-power indicator displays real power derived from its specified measurement inputs.
description: An active-power indicator displays real power derived from its specified measurement inputs. On an SLD it identifies the monitored feeder or source; the schematic supplies phase and ratio details.
readingNotes: Identify the power-flow sign reference at the measurement location.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Active-power indication differs from reverse-power protection, even when both use the same measured quantity.
